title: Yoma Yangon International Marathon 2027 Review: What the 2026 Edition Was Like
meta_description: Yoma Yangon International Marathon review: the race returned after five years on 22 February 2026 with 7,000+ runners, a half marathon past Shwedagon.
dek: Myanmar's biggest running event returned in February 2026 after a five-year break, with more than 7,000 runners in Yangon. Here is what that edition was like.
verdict: The Yoma Yangon International Marathon is back. After a five-year hiatus, its ninth edition was held on 22 February 2026 from the National Indoor Stadium 1 in Thuwunna, and more than 7,000 runners took part, according to the organisers [1]. There were three races: a 5 km fun run, a 10 km challenge run and a half marathon whose route took in the Strand and Shwedagon Pagoda [1]. It is Myanmar's largest running event [1]. If you want to run in Yangon, this is the race, though for now the longest distance is the half marathon.

sections.heading: The 2026 Edition
paragraphs: The race returned on the morning of 22 February 2026, after a five-year break, at the National Indoor Stadium 1 in Thuwunna, Yangon [1]. More than 7,000 runners took part, according to the organisers, the Yoma Group [1].
It was held eight times between 2013 and 2020, which made 2026 the ninth edition [1].

sections.heading: The Routes
paragraphs: All three races started from the stadium [1]. The half marathon ran along Waizayanta, Thanthuma and Upper and Lower Pazundaung roads to Maha Bandoola, Sandaku and the Strand, past Shwedagon Pagoda and back via Kyaikkasan to Waizayanta [1]. The 10 km and 5 km used shorter loops on the same roads [1].
Finishers within the time limit received medals, and the top ten men and women in the half marathon won cash prizes [1].

sections.heading: Should You Enter the 2027 Race?
paragraphs: Yes, if you want to run in Yangon. The half-marathon route is a genuine tour of the city, from the Strand to Shwedagon.
Check the travel advice for Myanmar before booking, and note that the 2026 race did not include a full marathon despite the name.
This review is compiled from state-media reporting on the 2026 edition. It is not a first-hand race report, and nobody from this site ran the race.

faqs.question: How many people ran the Yoma Yangon International Marathon in 2026?
faqs.answer: More than 7,000 runners took part on 22 February 2026, according to the organisers. It was the race's ninth edition and its first after a five-year break; it had been held eight times between 2013 and 2020.

faqs.question: What distances does the Yoma Yangon International Marathon offer?
faqs.answer: In 2026: a 5 km fun run, a 10 km challenge run and a half marathon. Despite its name, there was no full marathon. All races started and finished at the National Indoor Stadium 1, Thuwunna.

faqs.question: What is the Yoma Yangon half-marathon route like?
faqs.answer: A tour of central Yangon. In 2026 it ran from Thuwunna along the Pazundaung roads to Maha Bandoola, Sandaku and the Strand, passed Shwedagon Pagoda, and returned via Kyaikkasan.
